title: Appoint a food safety supervisor
what: Appoint at least one certified food safety supervisor for each premises before processing and selling by retail food the Division covers (ready-to-eat, potentially hazardous food), and keep one appointed.

sources.title: Food Act 2003 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The proprietor of a food business must ensure that before any food to which this Division applies is processed and sold by retail on premises in the course of carrying on the business at least one food safety supervisor has been appointed for the premises

reach.condition: if it processes and sells by retail food the Division covers
